journal_lines: Old tunnel in the cave wall. Followed it. Found what the miners left behind.
Someone dug here and stopped. Their ore stayed. Taking it now.
Abandoned shaft. Cobwebs on the tools. The stone underneath still had ore in it.
Found their pickaxe still leaning against the wall. Picked it up and set it back where they had left it.
Walked a tunnel they had hewn and forgotten. Their work was good work.
Old ladder rungs, half-rotted. Climbed down by feel. Did not look up.
A small handprint in the dust along the wall. Did not disturb it.
The tunnel ended in a wall they had been about to break through. Broke through it for them.
